item.title: Notes from Platform Seven
item.description:
Vestibulum id ligula porta felis euismod semper. A train station is a useful place to remember that everyone is carrying a different version of urgency.

An elderly traveller asks for the right platform. Someone points, then walks with her anyway. The departure board changes. Nobody is surprised.
